tools.name: list_projects_summary
tools.title: List projects summary
tools.description: Lists the Landscape projects this user owns, with their project numbers. Call this first when the user has not said which deal. List all active projects with key metrics (name, type, location, price, units/sf/acres, doc count). Works without project context.

property_type.description: Filter by project type code (LAND, MF, OFF, etc.)

tools.name: get_deal_summary
tools.title: Get deal summary
tools.description: Comprehensive project snapshot in one call: property basics, financials, debt, valuation, development budget total, absorption summary, headline returns (unlevered project-level IRR / equity multiple / NPV, basis-labeled), and data summary. Replaces 6-8 sequential reads. Use this for any 'give me a briefing / catch me up / where do we stand' ask covering budget, absorption, and/or returns together — every figure it returns is tool-sourced. The returns block is the UNLEVERED project-level basis (before financing); the levered/equity waterfall IRR is a different figure. For budget line-item detail call get_budget_items; the budget here is the aggregate total only.

tools.name: calculate_project_metrics
tools.title: Calculate project metrics
tools.description: Runs Landscape's engine for headline returns (IRR, equity multiple, NPV). The basis of each figure is labelled in the result. Trigger financial engine to compute IRR, NPV, budget variance, and investment metrics for a project.

tools.name: calculate_cash_flow
tools.title: Calculate cash flow
tools.description: Runs Landscape's engine for the cash flow schedule. Use detail_level 'summary' unless the user asks for annual or monthly periods. Generate period-by-period cash flow schedule. Routes to LandDev or IncomeProperty service based on project type.

tools.name: get_budget_rollup
tools.title: Get budget rollup
tools.description: Get a project-scoped budget rollup: names, row counts, summed amounts, percent of total, top-two concentration and grand total. Two groupings. group_by='category' (the default) rolls up by cost category -- 'break down the budget', 'budget by category', 'biggest budget categories', 'cost buckets'. group_by='level' with level 1, 2 or 3 rolls up by the project's OWN hierarchy levels (whatever it calls them -- village / phase / parcel on a land deal) -- 'budget by phase', 'cost by village', 'what is parcel 1.201 carrying', or any report variant grouped by where the money sits rather than what it buys. A level rollup rolls deeper lines UP: a line assigned to one parcel is counted inside its phase, so the phase totals are complete. A line sitting ABOVE the requested level keeps its own row and is flagged above_level -- say so rather than folding it into a member below it. Only state percentage shares returned by this tool. For raw individual line items, call get_budget_items.

group_by.description: What to group by. Defaults to category.

level.description: Which hierarchy level to roll up to when group_by='level'. 1 is the project's top level, 3 the deepest. Defaults to 2. The response carries level_label, the project's own name for it.

tools.name: get_budget_items
tools.title: Get budget items
tools.description: Development budget line items: description, category, quantity, rate, amount and timing. For totals by category use get_budget_rollup. Get budget line items with optional filters.

tools.name: get_areas
tools.title: Get areas
tools.description: The areas (top level of the land plan) in the project. Get area (level 1) containers for this project.

tools.name: get_phases
tools.title: Get phases
tools.description: The phases in the project, optionally within one area. Get phase (level 2) containers for this project.

tools.name: get_parcels
tools.title: Get parcels
tools.description: The parcels in the project with land use, product, acreage and unit counts; optionally within one phase or area. Get parcel (level 3) containers for this project.

tools.name: get_lots
tools.title: Get lots
tools.description: Retrieve lot records for the project. Supports parcel, parcel lot_type_id, and status filtering.

tools.name: get_absorption_schedule
tools.title: Get absorption schedule
tools.description: Absorption schedule rows: how many units are assumed to sell in each period, by phase, parcel or scenario. Get lot/unit absorption schedule.

tools.name: get_parcel_sale_assumptions
tools.title: Get parcel sale assumptions
tools.description: Retrieve sale assumptions for one or all parcels in a project. Returns per-parcel lot pricing, price escalation, closing costs, commission rates, and transaction cost assumptions.

parcel_id.description: Specific parcel ID. Omit to get assumptions for all parcels in the project.

tools.name: get_parcel_sale_events
tools.title: Get parcel sale events
tools.description: Recorded parcel sale events (bulk sales of finished parcels): buyer, status, dates and price. Get planned parcel sale events.

tools.name: get_loans
tools.title: Get loans
tools.description: The loans on the project and their terms. Get loan/debt structure for this project.

tools.name: get_project_documents
tools.title: Get project documents
tools.description: List all uploaded documents for this project. Soft-deleted documents are always excluded. Omit status_filter (or pass 'all') unless you specifically need one status — there is NO 'active' status in the data; 'active' is accepted only as a synonym for 'all'.

status_filter.description: Default 'all'. 'all'/'active' = every live document. Document statuses: 'draft' (uploaded, not indexed), 'processing', 'indexed'. Extraction statuses: 'pending', 'completed', 'failed'. An unrecognized value returns ALL live documents plus a 'filter_ignored' note — an empty list therefore means the project genuinely has no documents, never a bad filter.

tools.name: get_document_content
tools.title: Get document content
tools.description: The text of one project document. Find the document with get_project_documents first. Get extracted text content from a document.

tools.name: search_my_knowledge
tools.title: Search my knowledge
tools.description: Search the user's OWN knowledge: every document they have put into Landscape — files attached in staging (pre-project) chats, county records saved from the web, project documents — across all their chats and projects. Private to this user. Use it FIRST when the user asks about a property, site, deal or opportunity they have looked at before, or says 'what do we know', 'what did the report say', 'in my documents'; and before searching the web for facts the user may already hold. Returns matching passages with the document name and where it lives.

query.description: What to find, in plain words, e.g. 'Sierra Reflections conditions of approval fire station'.
